scope: Bounded validation of extraction methods for 30 outstanding jurisdictions; no production import

claims.offline_tested: Meaningful regression tests executed against delivered code
claims.retained_source_replayed: Delivered code parsed retained real source artifacts; source date and hash recorded
claims.live_route_verified: Current official routing/publication identity confirmed; not necessarily full text access
claims.live_sample_verified: Current source acquired and parsed, with source-to-output comparison
claims.inventory_verified: Complete in-scope hierarchy enumerated and independently checked
claims.full_collection_verified: Every source node in the complete agreed scope accounted; not implied by other statuses

review_requirements: Runnable documented entry point and dependency list without undocumented absolute workspace imports
Source identity includes jurisdiction, publication and actual source node or evidenced locator
No challenge, navigation or error shell accepted as law text
Tables, nested lists, notation and image order preserved or explicit unresolved status
Source revision and retained bytes bound to provenance and checkpoint
Bounded/sample mode cannot silently produce a whole-publication completion claim
Evidence dates, paths and SHA-256 hashes retained
Tests independently rerun by parent where runtime available
Live access failures, stale source routes and manual review requirements remain explicit
